Revival of an old resource pack, reimagines completely the model of many mobs, with new animations. Also changes some blocks to match the new mob changes, like the dried ghast and mob heads.

Here is the list of all changed mobs (with respective spawn eggs):

- Creeper (4 variants)
- Iron Golem
- Breeze
- Blaze
- Ghast
- Happy Ghast (& Ghastling)
- Skeleton
- Stray
- Bogged
- Parched
- Wither Skeleton
- Wither
- Ender Dragon
- Enderman
- Endermite

While here is the list of all changed blocks:
- Dried Ghast (with all states)
- All mob heads (whose mob has been changed)

Everything can be toggled on/off using the Respackopts Mod
